data.one_liner: Configurable and extensible text display for custom decorations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides SuperText and SuperTextWithSelection widgets to paint custom text selections, carets, highlights, and other layouts above or beneath text. It allows precise positioning based on lines and characters in the text layout.
use_when: You need to paint custom text selections, highlights, or carets.
You require multi-user text selections displayed in a single text block.
You want custom UI elements positioned relative to text characters and lines.
avoid_when: You only need standard Flutter Text or SelectableText widgets without custom decorations.
You are looking for a complete rich-text editor (use super_editor instead).
strengths: Supports single and multi-user text selections out of the box.
Enables custom painting above and beneath text using text layout information.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation for advanced custom UI layers.
Adds extra complexity compared to standard Flutter text widgets.
